response.sql:
SELECT r.raceId, r.name AS race_name, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS average_laps_completed
FROM results AS res
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE res.positionOrder >= 12
  AND res.laps IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(res.laps) <> ''
GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name
ORDER BY average_laps_completed DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The `laps` field contains numeric values or missing values, so casting it to a number gives the completed-lap count; missing values are excluded from the average.
